User Story: As a business requester, I want to submit a standardized software change request so that the delivery team receives the information required to understand my business need.
As a business analyst, I want incomplete requests identified before engineering review so that engineering teams do not spend time assessing unclear requirements.
As a stakeholder, I want to view the current status and owner of a request so that I do not rely on manual email follow-ups.
As an engineer, I want to record feasibility, dependencies and risks so that implementation decisions are based on documented technical analysis.
As a product owner, I want approved requests converted into prioritized backlog items so that the team can plan work according to business value and delivery capacity.
As a developer, I want each user story to contain clear acceptance criteria before development begins so that expected behaviour is understood before implementation.
As a QA analyst, I want test scenarios linked to requirements and acceptance criteria so that I can verify the delivered change against the business need.
As a QA analyst, I want to record test outcomes and associated defects so that unresolved issues are visible before business acceptance.
As a business approver, I want to approve successfully tested functionality so that only changes meeting the intended business need are marked ready for release.
As a business analyst, I want to review status, ownership and approval history so that decisions and handoffs remain traceable.
As a process owner, I want workflow rules to prevent incomplete requests from progressing so that required reviews, testing and approvals occur in sequence.
